precepts.text: Judith braided the hair of her head, and this is why it matters for the sisters to return to their natural bushy hair and stop putting chemicals in it, laying down the fashions of the world.
precepts.point: His head is as the most fine gold, and his locks are bushy and black as a raven; this is the same as reading of the Christ having woolly hair and the Most High having hair of pure wool.

note.label: Song of Solomon 5: My Beloved Is White and Ruddy

precepts.why:
The beloved's locks are bushy. Judith “braided the hair of her head, and put on a tire upon it, and put on her garments of gladness, wherewith she was clad during the life of Manasses her husband.”

This is why it matters for the sisters to return to their natural bushy hair and stop putting chemicals in it, laying down the fashions of the world. Judith washed, anointed herself with precious ointment and braided her own hair.

moments.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: The second sign is her desire being unto her husband, and what that is really going into is that her job is to serve him and to please him.

Judith put off the garments of her widowhood, washed herself, anointed herself with precious ointment, braided her hair and put on the garments of gladness she used to wear while her husband was alive. The way a woman dresses tells you whether her desire is unto her husband.

A woman is supposed to dress nice for her man, not to go out with her friends, not for a job interview, not to look good for a boss. These black women look good for everybody but their men; they come home and put some crap on their face.

When a woman stops taking care of herself, overeating until she is obese and unattractive, not even putting on some nice lingerie to appease her man, her desire is not unto you. I am not talking about putting on weight; everybody puts on weight as time goes on.

You know how sisters stand over you waiting for you to taste the food, just watching you eat for you to say it is good? That is a sign her desire is unto you. So is wanting you: if your woman does not want to have sex with you, her desire is not unto you.
